_meta.title: Mediclinic admission summary / patient information sheet
_meta.orientation: portrait; commonly photographed rotated 90°, with the MEDICLINIC wordmark on the left edge
_meta.nature: system-printed at admission, not handwritten; only the consent circles and the footer block are completed by hand
_meta.note: Field map only. No patient data from any real form is recorded here — value entries are types and format patterns, never live identifiers.

identityWarning: This page carries up to three distinct people (patient, medical-aid main member, signatory) and two employers (the member's and the patient's). They are frequently different individuals. Never merge them into one identity and never copy an identifier across blocks.

consents._note: Pre-printed YES/NO pairs under 'Admission information'. Record only the one circled; omit the path when neither is marked. An unmarked consent is a real finding.
consents.consents.belongings: 1|2 — 1 = left with family/friends, 2 = taken to the nursing unit at own risk; circled by hand

formatPatterns.ageText: NNyNNm, e.g. 56y10m — years and months since birth
formatPatterns.bed: ward letter / bed identifier, e.g. L / LS04
formatPatterns.practiceNo: numeric practice number; the admitting doctor's is printed inline after the name as Prac#
formatPatterns.icd10: letter, two digits, optional dot and subdivision

sectionOrder: sticker header (barcode, case no, date, bed, age, patient, admitting doctor, DOB, ID, contact, scheme)
facility block (logo, address, telephone, VAT and registration numbers, practice number)
declaration blocks (Take Home Medication, Take Note, NB, Consent to Release Patient Information, Indemnity, belongings options)
footer (FINAL DIAGNOSIS, PROCEDURE, SIGNATURE DOCTOR, DATE)

anchors.wordmark: MEDICLINIC in blue lowercase-weighted caps with the square glyph logo, top of page
anchors.facilityLine: Mediclinic <site name> followed by a street address, PO Box, Tel and Fax
anchors.labelStyle: monospace labels padded with dot leaders before the colon — Med.Aid....:, ID#....:, Age....: — the single strongest structural signature
anchors.auditLine: Admit...: and Printed: each with a timestamp and a By: operator username
anchors.codeTable: header reading T.c ID Code Mod Description
anchors.consentList: Admission information with right-aligned YES/NO pairs
anchors.footerBlock: FINAL DIAGNOSIS, PROCEDURE, SIGNATURE DOCTOR and DATE ruled lines across the foot
anchors.formCode: boxed form code D 2700 at the outer edge
anchors.declarationOpening: I hereby authorise the hospital to provide any information of whatever nature concerning my hospitalisation

crosswalk._note: Where a value also exists on the SASA form, so an admission photo can seed the case.
crosswalk.member.title: account.title
crosswalk.nextOfKin[0].name: account.familyFriend

crosswalkCaveats: account.* on the SASA form means the person responsible for the account. On this page that is the medical-aid main member, who is often not the patient — take account.surname/title/initials/employer from member.*, not from patient.*.
account.idNo on the SASA form sits in the account holder's block but is conventionally the patient's identity number. Confirm which the practice intends before mapping either.
The CPT codes here are procedure codes for the hospital account, not the anaesthetic billing codes that populate codes.<code> on the SASA form. Do not import them into that block.
